name: mmo-chip
description: Give Claude the mmo-chip dies (each approved once in the app): photo, all annotations and annotated renders; plus markup, wire or full edits when allowed per die.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the dies of a running mmo-chip instance (IC reverse engineering from die photos). Claude can view the die image at any zoom and read every annotation: nets, cells, pins, analog layers, comments, floorplan regions and rulers. Claude can render annotated images of the layout (highlights, arrows, boxes) and attach them to comments. Writes are off by default; the die's MCP tab in mmo-chip can allow markup (comments, floorplan regions, rulers), wires and vias, or full edits of every annotation. Those changes have their own undo/redo stack in that tab.

The first time Claude uses a die, mmo-chip asks you to approve it.

Copy the endpoint URL from the die viewer's MCP tab (right panel).
